Authentic Malaysian food finally! Love the classy yet casual house setting.
Oct 2024 • Family
Many Malaysian food joints came and gone from Saigon over the years, while those surviving near Ben Thanh Market were simply not good.

Appreciate that Lesung Restaurant opened! Finally a quiet and classy place to tuck into delicious Malaysian food again. While the prices could be slightly higher here than other Singaporean/Malaysian food joints in town, but we felt that the authentic flavours, sheer variety of dishes that we missed and the clean enjoyable ambience make it all worthwhile.

Ordered classic dishes such as:
- Roti Canai 
- Nasi Lemak
- Prawn Otak-Otak
- Butter Chicken
- Ikan Bakar
- Durian Cendol
They remembered to include the humble "Keropok" (prawn crackers) and "Achar" (pickled salad) which is rare to find these days. The sambal was great. The creaminess of their butter chicken, Otak-Otak and even the tender fish was awesome. Teh Tarik's pretty authentic too. Hope to try their other dishes next time.

Also cute are their Batik-design serviettes, newspaper-style menu, and the story of how this restaurant was named after the founder/chef's grandma's 150-year old mortar.

Best Halal Restaurant in Saigon
Oct 2024 • Family
Came here with my family as were we craving for Malaysian food that is halal. Halal eateries are limited, we were glad we found Lesung. When we arrived, we were greeted pleasantly. 

WOW! The ambiance was so relaxed, spectacular deco, lovely classic musics, its as if we were back in time during the era. Nostalgic!

The food was second to none. From the day we ate here, we came back almost everyday where somedays we use GRAB to sent it to our hotel.

We basically have ate almost every food on the menu. I can’t choose whats the best. Everything was delicious. 

Loved their Nasi Lemak, Roti Canai, Ikan Bakar, Asam Pedas, basically everything. Some dishes are so unique that it beats the taste of food in Malaysia. 

I am from Malaysia and I have plentifully options but I am drooling seeing the food photos and I can’t wait to be back in Vietnam only for the reason of going back to Lesung. It’s funny that a Malaysian wants to go to Lesung Saigon to have the best Malaysian food. 😂
